analysis.paired_reporting: show every row and pair decisions/outcomes within checkpoint and dataset
analysis.primary_unit: reward checkpoint crossed with confirmation dataset
analysis.success_criterion: the frozen sign screen has lower mean decision regret than both always-optimize and the frozen best-of-N screen on new learned-reward checkpoints
analysis.uncertainty: hierarchical bootstrap over reward-training seed and evaluation document; external controls reported separately

baselines.best_of_n_rule: exact expectation over uniformly drawn candidate subsets on calibration data; optimize iff primary-N selected human quality exceeds uniform

confirmation_data.evaluation: all eligible segments in documents disjoint from calibration
confirmation_data.optimization: all eligible segments from calibration documents; human labels opened only for the one frozen calibration segment per document

development_evidence.status: already viewed; used only to freeze this rule

human_scoring.aggregation: average rater-level segment penalties; do not average error rows directly
human_scoring.candidate_quality: negative mean rater penalty, so larger values are better
human_scoring.rater_penalty: sum error penalties within segment, system, and rater
human_scoring.source: pinned google/wmt-mqm-human-evaluation README at the manifest revision

optimization.checkpoint_rule: first checkpoint reaching each target; report unreachable targets
optimization.pressure_measure: mean KL(pi || uniform) in nats on the optimization pool

secondary: human-quality curve over the full KL grid
proxy-reward curve over the full KL grid

policy.scorer: one shared linear vector; no system identity or bias

predictor.decision_rule: optimize iff cosine > 0; ties and nonfinite values keep the initial policy
predictor.human_gradient_data: one frozen segment from each calibration document and frozen train systems
predictor.name: initial text-policy human/reward gradient cosine
predictor.reward_gradient_data: all eligible segments in calibration documents and frozen train systems; no human outcomes required
predictor.reward_standardization: mean zero and unit variance on the reward-gradient pool
predictor.theory: the sign is the first-order predicted human-quality change under the reward update

text_policy_predictor_protocol.research_question: Can the sign of a pre-optimization first-order human/reward alignment screen choose between reward optimization and the initial policy on new reward seeds and document-disjoint human-rated candidate pools?

tokenization_paper.scope: same-string estimator validation and NLLB length-tilt feasibility; no RL training effect

notes: Joint probability is p_theta(string) times q_phi(path|string).
Ordinary response-mean REINFORCE is invariant to q_phi for string-only reward.
Global token mean uses each sampled batch's total token count, so its expected sample weighting depends on q_phi.
Position weighting is an explicit alternative estimator and must not be confused with the joint behavior score.
synthetic.scope: exact finite synthetic policy; not an MT result
